scenario: Malformed / incomplete source — safe stop and input-integrity failure
description: Architecture artifact produced when the PRD input was unreadable or critically incomplete. Expected: input-integrity blocker recorded, no invented requirements, validation flags false.

requirements.text: Input document could not be fully parsed — content was truncated or unreadable.

blockers.text: Input document is malformed, truncated, or unreadable. Architecture generation stopped.
blockers.impact: No requirements could be reliably extracted. Architecture cannot be produced without a readable, complete PRD. Action: Provide a readable copy of the intended source document.

open_questions.question: Is the correct, complete PRD available? Please provide a readable version to proceed.
open_questions.impact: Architecture cannot proceed without a valid source.

assumptions: Architecture generation was stopped early due to input integrity failure — no assumptions were made about content.
